original_product_snapshot.name: goat's milk & glycerin CHUNK SOAP
original_product_snapshot.description:
A natural, glycerin-rich soap that will leave your skin feeling soft and refreshed. Makes a wonderful shaving soap!

 - 100% vegetarian ingredients. All our products are cruelty free... tested on friends, not animals.

 - Handmade in Appleton, WI

 - No parabens or phthalates.

 - Size: 2.5" x 3.5" x 1" / approximately 5oz

Ingredients: saponified oils of coconut, palm, castor and safflower, vegetable glycerin, purified water, goat's milk, sorbitol, sorbitan oleate, soy protein, titanium dioxide, fragrance & color.

 
***Wholesale Customers ***

Goat's Milk & Glycerin Chunk Soaps must be ordered in case packs of 6 per fragrance.
